sloka: तं भीमवपुषं दृष्ट्वा रथस्थं रथिनां वरम्।अभिपेतुर्महात्मानो ये प्रधाना वनौकसः ।। ६.७१.३८ ।।
transliteration: taṁ bhīmavapuṣaṁ dṛṣṭvā rathasthaṁ rathināṁ varam।abhipeturmahātmāno ye pradhānā vanaukasaḥ ।। 6.71.38 ।।

translations.english: Observing the dreadful enemy seated on the chariot, the foremost of the great Vanaras rushed towards him.
